visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A bearded man wearing a dark blue CTBC Brothers baseball jersey and a branded baseball cap stands in what appears to be a dugout. He holds a black baseball glove with yellow stitching. He extends his left forearm to display a tattoo featuring three small, colorful outlined hearts in green, pink, and purple. A woman's hand enters the frame, pointing at the tattoos while he explains their significance. The lighting is bright and natural, characteristic of a semi-outdoor stadium environment with blue background walls and metal racks. (2) The man continues his explanation, gesturing toward his arm while the off-screen woman translates his Spanish into Chinese subtitles. His facial expressions are warm and expressive as he looks between the interviewer and his tattoos. He briefly interacts with his baseball glove, which features the ZETT brand logo prominently. The background features blue stadium walls and professional sports equipment, maintaining a consistent athletic context throughout the shot. (3) After revealing that his wife is currently pregnant, the man breaks into a large, joyful smile with visible happiness in his eyes. He crosses his arms over his chest, proudly displaying the tattoo once more. The camera remains steady in a medium shot, capturing his emotional reaction and the celebratory atmosphere as the interviewer presumably congratulates him off-camera. He appears relaxed and content.
